title.context: Insights: heading of the FIRE card.

target.message: Living off your savings takes about {amount}: {multiple} times a year of your spending ({spending}).
target.context: FIRE card: the target. {multiple} is a number (25), the rest formatted money.

progress.context: FIRE card: accessible label of the progress bar.

years.message: At {monthly} a month, as you've been saving, that's about {years} years away.
years.context: FIRE card: time to get there. {years} is a number like 18.5.

notAtThisPace.message: At the pace you've been saving, not within a lifetime: every bit more a month brings it closer.
notAtThisPace.context: FIRE card: never at this pace.

reached.message: You're there: your savings could cover your spending for good.

note.message: The "4% rule": take out 4% a year and it's likely to last. Assumes {rate}% a year growth after inflation; an estimate to steer by.
note.context: FIRE card: note. {rate} is a number.
